name: The Shops at Mission Viejo
description: The Shops at Mission Viejo is a premier upscale shopping destination in Orange County, featuring over 150 specialty stores and restaurants anchored by Nordstrom and Macy's. This modern enclosed regional mall offers a sophisticated shopping experience with a diverse mix of fashion, dining, and entertainment options in the heart of Mission Viejo.
summary: An upscale regional shopping mall in Orange County offering over 150 stores with department store anchors and premium retail experiences.
